clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that instructs adventurers on the essentials of wilderness camping through the art of cooking. By learning to start a campfire from local trainers like Zarrin in Dolanaar, travelers establish the necessary anchor for setting up wilderness camps. It marks the first step toward mastering outdoor survival and outfitting personal campsites.

Every long journey across the wilderness begins with the ability to build a warm fire. In Camping 101: Cooking, fledgling adventurers are directed to seek out culinary training as their initial lesson in bushcraft. Learning to cook is more than preparing meals from wild game; the essential skill of lighting a basic campfire serves as the physical and practical anchor for any outdoor camp. Without a fire to ward off the chill and keep the dark at bay, establishing a reliable campsite in the wilds is impossible.

Learning to kindle a basic campfire grants the ability to establish modest camps throughout the wilderness. Although an entry-level camp can support only a few rudimentary furnishings, dedicated adventurers can expand their capabilities. As an adventurer hones their cooking proficiency, they unlock methods to kindle larger, sturdier blazes. Furthermore, artisans versed in other tradeskills can consult their respective trainers to learn how to craft furnishings and improvements to enrich their camps.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Progress
paras: A good campfire is the foundation to any good camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
